Phoenix Party Bus Rental

Scottsdale Sprinters rents a chauffeured party bus in Phoenix and across the metro: the Party Bus (28 Pax) is $250 an hour on a 4-hour minimum, so a night starts at $1,000 before 8% Arizona sales tax, about $36 a person across its 28 seats. Smaller groups take a Limo Party Sprinter from $175 an hour, and a 50% deposit holds the date.

Last updated: October 1, 2026

Planning a night that starts and ends in Scottsdale? See our Scottsdale party bus rental page.

How much does a party bus rental in Phoenix cost?

The Party Bus (28 Pax) is $250 an hour on a 4-hour minimum, so a Phoenix party bus night starts at $1,000 before 8% Arizona sales tax. Split across all 28 seats, that is about $36 a person. A 5-hour night on the bus is $1,250. The party vehicles on this page run $175–$295 an hour, each on its own minimum, and the price is for the vehicle, not per head: a full bus and a half-full one pay the same. The rate table on this page carries every party vehicle's rate, minimum and seats. Check availability and request a quote for your own date and route.

Is a party bus or a limo cheaper in Phoenix?

Per hour, a limo-seated Sprinter is cheaper; per person, a full bus can be. The Limo Party Sprinter (16 Pax) is $175 an hour against $250 for the Party Bus (28 Pax). At each vehicle's minimum the Limo Party Sprinter (16 Pax) starts at $700 (about $44 a seat across 16) and the bus at $1,000 (about $36 across 28). The Pink Hummer Limo is $295 an hour for 18, and the Ultra Luxury Party Sprinter $250 for 15. So the rule is headcount first: fill the smallest vehicle the group fits, and the bus wins once the group outgrows a Sprinter.

How many people fit, and which vehicle is the right size?

The party vehicles seat 13 to 28. Up to 16 take a Limo Party Sprinter, up to 18 the Pink Hummer Limo, and up to 28 the Party Bus (28 Pax), the only bus in the set. We run one Party Bus (28 Pax), so a group past its 28 seats adds a Limo Party Sprinter alongside it, each on its own reservation. Seated capacity is a ceiling, not a target: a group that wants room to move books one size up.

What is on board the Phoenix party bus?

On board the Party Bus (28 Pax): designer limo seats, built for comfort; two wet bars; opulent wood floor; best-in-class subwoofers and sound. The lighting is fiber optic lights; bar lights; window lights; hub lights, and every light switches on its own, so the bus runs as a full light show or, lights down, as a quiet ride home. Your chauffeur drives the whole night, and bottled water is on board.

Can we drink on a Phoenix party bus?

Passengers 21 and over bring their own alcohol, and we do not sell it. Arizona vehicle-for-hire open-container policy, A.R.S. § 4-251, allows it, and if anyone under 21 rides, no alcohol comes on that trip. No underage drinking. Anyone under 21 stays on soft drinks. Two house rules carry a fee: $1,500 for smoking or vaping and $450 for an excessive spill. The Arizona alcohol guide linked below covers the law in full.

Where in the Phoenix metro does the party bus pick up?

Anywhere in the published service area: Phoenix, Scottsdale, Paradise Valley, Tempe, Mesa, Chandler, Gilbert, Glendale, Cave Creek and San Tan Valley. The hourly rate is the same in every one of them, and distance is not billed separately, so the drive between your stops sits inside the hours you reserve. List every address on the quote request: the first pickup, each stop, and the last drop-off. A night that starts in one city and ends in another is booked exactly like one that stays downtown.

What Phoenix nights is a party bus booked for?

Birthdays, bachelor and bachelorette nights, concert and game nights, and a night out for a group that wants to arrive together. Prom and homecoming groups ride too, alcohol-free. Each occasion has its own page below with packages built for it. The vehicle does not change with the occasion; the extras do. A birthday adds decor and a sign, a bachelorette adds decor in her colours, a concert night keeps it simple and gets everyone home together.

How do I book a party bus in Phoenix?

Pick the vehicle and the hours, request a quote with the date, the headcount and every address, then confirm with a 50% deposit. Arizona sales tax of 8% is added at checkout. The pricing page carries the rates and the live availability check. You can also call or text (623) 986-6339 or email reservations@scottsdalesprinters.com. Cancellation terms are published in full on the policies page.

Is a Phoenix party bus priced differently from Scottsdale?

No. Scottsdale Sprinters runs the same vehicles, rates, minimums and house rules across the metro from one reservations desk. A night that starts and ends in Scottsdale is answered in Scottsdale terms on the Scottsdale party bus page, linked below.
